limits: All accounts/business records are isolated local synthetic fixtures.

11-pools-closed is an explicit GET visual-state stub and does not prove the service actually has no activity.
12-preferences-on is an unsaved UI interaction and does not prove persisted preferences.

Current source has later zero-radius input borders, amendment helper, neutral participation sequence, narrow notice title and Stock Apple-field helper fixes. These screenshots retain their actual corrected/d5 bundle hashes. Root captures those changes separately and overrides case + width in the main index; this manifest does not claim to show the later build.
Known requirement/model/image gaps are recorded in business-findings.md and VISUAL_QA.md; visual results are not pixel-identical claims.
